topic_title: Reducing Risk — Accepting or Yielding Right-of-Way
prompt: What is the correct reduced-risk decision when an aggressive motorist attempts to steal your right-of-way?

options.text: Accelerate sharply to establish your legal ownership of the intersection
Block the intersection to force the aggressive driver to stop and apologize
Follow the driver closely while honking to notify nearby police units
Surrender the right-of-way calmly and allow the aggressive driver to pass
